title: ADP MCP 对接配置
description: 连接您的来也 ADP 账号，用于在 WorkBuddy 中调用 ADP 的文档解析与抽取能力。API Key 仅存储在本机。
description_en: Connect your Laiye ADP account to use ADP document parsing and extraction capabilities in WorkBuddy. The API Key is stored only on this device.
docLabel: 如何获取 ADP API Key？
docLabel_en: How to get an ADP API Key?

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 在 ADP 个人设置「我的MCP」中获取
fields.placeholder_en: Get it from ADP Personal Settings > My MCP
fields.description: 用于连接您的 ADP 账号，启用文档解析、票据识别和信息抽取能力。
fields.description_en: Used to connect your ADP account and enable document parsing, invoice recognition, and information extraction.
